steps.title: Select pipette mount positions
steps.instruction: Choose the mount position (left or right) for the P20 Multichannel GEN2 pipette and for the P300 Multichannel GEN2 pipette.

steps.title: Enter sample count
steps.instruction: Enter the total number of samples for the run; because both pipettes are 8‑channel, the number of samples should be a multiple of 8 or as close as possible, otherwise an extra full column of tips will be used.

steps.title: Configure temperature modules
steps.instruction: Specify which temperature module (if any) to load in slot 1, slot 4, and slot 7:

substeps.instruction: Slot 1: optional module to control the temperature of the sample plate during part 1 of the protocol.
Slot 4: optional module to control the temperature of reagent plate 1 during part 1 and the primer plate during part 2.
Slot 7: optional module to control the temperature of reagent plate 2 during part 1 and the indexing plate during part 2.

steps.title: Load plates onto deck
steps.instruction: Place the following plates in their designated slots:

substeps.instruction: Sample plate – holds DNA samples and will be mixed with buffers/reagents in part 1.
Reagent 1 plate – contains the first mixing reagent (e.g., a buffer or enzyme) in column 1.
Reagent 2 plate – contains the second mixing reagent (e.g., a buffer or enzyme) in column 1.
Primer plate – contains primers to be mixed with DNA samples in step 2.
